name: Bundle
description: Tier card shown in the #bundles section (Starter 2 / Most popular 3 / Whole home 5). Product count is derived from the `products` list so marketing can't desync the number and the art; the per-product line is computed from price/count in Liquid.

field_definitions.name: Tag / badge
field_definitions.description: Pill above the title, e.g. "Starter", "Most popular", "Whole home".

field_definitions.name: Products
field_definitions.description: Products in the tier, order preserved. Renders the art strip; count is derived from this list.

field_definitions.name: Compare-at price
field_definitions.description: MRP sum for the strikethrough. Empty hides it.

field_definitions.name: Bullets
field_definitions.description: Check list items (2-3). Each bullet renders with a green check.

field_definitions.name: Highlight
field_definitions.description: Most-popular tier: amber ring + primary CTA.

field_definitions.name: CTA label
field_definitions.description: Button label, e.g. "Build this box". Empty falls back to the section default.

field_definitions.name: CTA link
field_definitions.description: Where the CTA goes. Empty falls back to the section default link.
